report: gitea/go-gitea v1.25.5 batch 9 row-level review (open advisories)
scope: seven promotions from fix-attributed hunks plus four feature-absence exclusions
method: anchor = the frozen line the fix removes, the frozen line an inserted guard is attached to, or the frozen line whose behaviour the fix replaces; marker must be absent from the frozen enclosing function and present in the fix patch added lines. Exclusions require the described code path to be absent from the frozen tree.

not_affected.basis: Scoped and cross-repository reusable workflows do not exist at v1.25.5: CanReadWorkflowCrossRepo, MatchScopedWorkflows and ActionsConfig.IsCollaborativeOwner are absent from the frozen tree (grep over --include=*.go returns no hits), so the collaborative-owner read path the advisory describes has no pre-image to anchor; the feature was introduced after the snapshot while the OSV range only reflects the 1.27.0 fix release.

The filtered-workflow synthetic skipped status path does not exist at v1.25.5: handleFilteredWorkflows and CreateSkippedCommitStatusForFilteredWorkflow are absent and workflows excluded by branch or path filters are simply never scheduled, so the bypass that satisfies a required check with a skipped status has no pre-image; the path was added after the snapshot while the OSV range only reflects the 1.27.0 fix release.

Actions job-level concurrency does not exist at v1.25.5: no concurrency field, group or cancellation code exists in models/actions, services/actions or modules/actions, and checkJobsOfCurrentRunAttempt is absent, so the cross-run cancellation that re-emitted blocked fork jobs has no pre-image; the feature was introduced after the snapshot while the OSV range only reflects the 1.27.0 fix release.

The media API at v1.25.5 already serves repository blobs through routers/common.ServeContentByReader, which passes ServeHeaderOptions{Filename} to modules/httplib and sets a sniffed Content-Type (text/plain for HTML) plus the disposition headers, so a committed HTML file is not rendered; the header-less ctx.Resp.Write(lfsPointerBuf) path the advisory fixes was introduced by a later refactor and is not present at the frozen tag.

not_promotable.reason: The advisory cites de4b8277e9cb (#38406), but that patch contains no release-edit attachment rename hunk and no cached commit touches routers/web/repo/release.go EditReleasePost or the upload.Verify allow-list call, so the pre-image cannot be tied to a fix.

The advisory cites de4b8277e9cb, but that patch does not add webhook cleanup to DeleteCollaboration (the 1.27 hunk only removes WatchRepoAuto and tightens ReconsiderWatches), and no cached commit removes or disables collaborator webhooks, so there is no fix-attributed anchor.

The 256-combination matrix limit lives in the actionslib dependency upgraded by 13033827b1a9 (jobparser BlockSafeString types); the in-repo hunks of that commit only adapt to the new types and add no limit, so the defect is not verifiable in the frozen repository.
